next_step: Finalize EU-region latency numbers + commit tier conversation; procurement kickoff
notes:
Account snapshot: Halifax Crest (mid-market EU SaaS for product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as quick start; plan to move to Dedicated if POC meets latency/cost targets. Team: Head of Product (Arielle Kowalski), Platform Eng (Tomás Varga), CTO (Erdem Kaya).

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2024-11-12: inbound signup, quick discovery email (Maya) — initial interest: chat + search for product UI.
- 2024-12-03: intro call (FF id ff_20241203_hcrest_intro) — demo of hosted API, basic integration notes. Interested in Llama-family open models; asked about quantized variants.
- 2025-01-08: security questionnaire sent (SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS). Legal flagged data residency requirement for EU-only storage.
- 2025-01-22: demo of console + routing policies. Showed per-route cost breakdown and fallback policies.
- 2025-02-12: POC kickoff call (ff_20250212_poc_kickoff). Scope: chat flows + semantic search on 500k docs (scrubbed). POC plan: hosted API for integration, then parallel Dedicated benchmark for consistent throughput.
- 2025-02-18: latency benchmark run using EU region (Frankfurt) — results: average 160-210ms for chat token steps; tail p95 ~ 340ms under current batching. Team requested improvement to get p95 < 300ms.
- 2025-02-20: pricing call with finance — exploring committed v CPU/GPU tiers vs pay-as-you-go; Redwood pricing deck shared (drive link).

Use-case & requirements (shorthand):
- Primary: in-product conversational assistant for analytics (short-turn chat, context window ~2k tokens).
- Secondary: embeddings for doc search + reranking of candidate results.
- Latency SLO: target median <120-150ms for single-turn chat; p95 <300ms. Throughput target: 80-150 reqs/sec during business hours. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to commit for discount if predictable.
- Model preference: open models compatible w/ continuous batching; willing to test 7B/13B quantized variants. Need support for fallback to smaller family when load spikes.

Security / residency notes:
- EU data residency mandatory for production PII-adjacent telemetry. Legal wants DPA clause and confirmation on encrypted at rest keys (bring-your-own KMS).
- Request: private deployment (Dedicated) with VPC peering and customer KMS; but initial POC must be on Hosted EU region to shorten time-to-eval.
- Audit logging retention: 12 months for request/response metadata; full content retention only on explicit opt-in and scrubbed.

Technical feedback from SE run:
- Redwood suggested KV/prefix caching for common conversational contexts — reduced token costs in tests by ~18%.
- Model routing: want automatic EU-only routing, with configurable multi-region failover to NA for short windows; concern: cross-region latency vs availability tradeoff.
- SE notes: can hit target p95 <300ms with tuned batching + dedicated pool in eu-central-1; recommended quantized variant + autoscaler min capacity to avoid cold starts.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Finance prefers 12-mo committed Dedicated pool if Redwood can guarantee average per-token cost savings >=25% vs hosted payg.
- Procurement timeline: internal procurement kickoff scheduled for 2025-03-05; legal DPA review in parallel. Forecast month 2025-03.

Quotes / call highlights:
- "We need EU residency nailed down before we can point customers to the assistant." — Arielle Kowalski (Head of Product).
- "If we can see stable p95 under 300ms on Dedicated, it's an easy 'yes' from Eng" — Tomás Varga (Platform Eng).

Open action items (CRM style):
- SE (Luca) to publish tuned benchmark results on Dedicated pool (EU) and expected p95 improvement by 2025-02-28.
- Sales (Maya) to negotiate committed tier pricing; provide two commitment options (6mo, 12mo) by 2025-03-03.
- Legal to receive DPA + KMS integration whitepaper; Redwood security team to confirm BYOK implementation details.
- PO: confirm scrubbed PII dataset acceptance and retention flags for POC.

Blockers: EU residency confirmation (legal), final p95 numbers under Dedicated, procurement signoff.

Staging remarks: account is high-probability close if Dedicated p95 targets are met and price commit shows >=20% cost savings vs hosted. Keep cadence: weekly technical sync + bi-weekly commercial update.
